006package dev.metaschema.core.qname;
007
008import java.util.Optional;
009import java.util.regex.Matcher;
010import java.util.regex.Pattern;
011
012import javax.xml.XMLConstants;
013
014import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
015import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
016import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
017import nl.talsmasoftware.lazy4j.Lazy;
018
019/**
020 * A factory that produces qualified names.
021 * <p>
022 * This implementation uses an underlying integer-based cache to reduce the
023 * memory footprint of qualified names and namespaces by reusing instances with
024 * the same namespace and local name.
025 */
026public final class EQNameFactory {
027  private static final Pattern URI_QUALIFIED_NAME = Pattern.compile("^Q\\{([^{}]*)\\}(.+)$");
028  private static final Pattern LEXICAL_NAME = Pattern.compile("^(?:([^:]+):)?(.+)$");
029  @NonNull
030  private static final Lazy<EQNameFactory> INSTANCE = ObjectUtils.notNull(Lazy.of(EQNameFactory::new));
031
032  @NonNull
033  private final QNameCache cache;
034
035  /**
036   * Get the singleton instance.
037   *
038   * @return the singleton instance
039   */
040  @NonNull
041  public static EQNameFactory instance() {
042    return ObjectUtils.notNull(INSTANCE.get());
043  }
044
045  private EQNameFactory() {
046    // disable construction
047    this(QNameCache.instance());
048  }
049
050  private EQNameFactory(@NonNull QNameCache cache) {
051    this.cache = cache;
052  }
053
054  /**
055   * Get an existing qualified name by looking up the cached entry using the
056   * provided index value.
057   *
058   * @param index
059   *          the index value to lookup
060   * @return an optional containing the qualified name, if it exists
061   */
062  @NonNull
063  public Optional<IEnhancedQName> get(int index) {
064    return ObjectUtils.notNull(Optional.ofNullable(cache.get(index)));
065  }
066
067  /**
068   * Get a new qualified name based on the provided namespace and local name.
069   *
070   * @param namespace
071   *          the namespace part of the qualified name
072   * @param localName
073   *          the local part of the qualified name
074   *
075   * @return the qualified name
076   */
077  @NonNull
078  public IEnhancedQName newQName(@NonNull String namespace, @NonNull String localName) {
079    return cache.cachedQNameFor(namespace, localName);
080  }
081
082  /**
083   * Parse a name as a qualified name.
084   * <p>
085   * The name can be:
086   * <ul>
087   * <li>A URI qualified name of the form <code>Q{URI}name</code>, where the URI
088   * represents the namespace
089   * <li>A lexical name of the forms <code>prefix:name</code> or
090   * <code>name</code>, where the prefix represents the namespace
091   * </ul>
092   *
093   * @param name
094   *          the name to parse
095   * @param resolver
096   *          the prefix resolver to use to determine the namespace for a given
097   *          prefix
098   * @return the parsed qualified name
099   */
100  @NonNull
101  public IEnhancedQName parseName(
102      @NonNull String name,
103      @NonNull PrefixToNamespaceResolver resolver) {
104    Matcher matcher = URI_QUALIFIED_NAME.matcher(name);
105    return matcher.matches()
106        ? newUriQualifiedName(matcher)
107        : parseLexicalQName(name, resolver);
108  }
109
110  /**
111   * Parse a URI qualified name.
112   * <p>
113   * The name is expected to be a URI qualified name of the form
114   * <code>{URI}name</code>, where the URI represents the namespace.
115   *
116   * @param name
117   *          the name to parse
118   * @return the parsed qualified name
119   */
120  @NonNull
121  public IEnhancedQName parseUriQualifiedName(@NonNull String name) {
122    Matcher matcher = URI_QUALIFIED_NAME.matcher(name);
123    if (!matcher.matches()) {
124      throw new IllegalArgumentException(
125          String.format("The name '%s' is not a valid BracedURILiteral of the form: Q{URI}local-name", name));
126    }
127    return newUriQualifiedName(matcher);
128  }
129
130  @NonNull
131  private IEnhancedQName newUriQualifiedName(@NonNull Matcher matcher) {
132    return cache.cachedQNameFor(
133        ObjectUtils.notNull(matcher.group(1)),
134        ObjectUtils.notNull(matcher.group(2)));
135  }
136
137  /**
138   * Parse a lexical name as a qualified name.
139   * <p>
140   * The name is expected to be a lexical name of the forms
141   * <code>prefix:name</code> or <code>name</code>, where the prefix represents
142   * the namespace.
143   *
144   * @param name
145   *          the name to parse
146   * @param resolver
147   *          the prefix resolver to use to determine the namespace for a given
148   *          prefix
149   * @return the parsed qualified name
150   */
151  @NonNull
152  public IEnhancedQName parseLexicalQName(
153      @NonNull String name,
154      @NonNull PrefixToNamespaceResolver resolver) {
155    Matcher matcher = LEXICAL_NAME.matcher(name);
156    if (!matcher.matches()) {
157      throw new IllegalArgumentException(
158          String.format("The name '%s' is not a valid lexical QName of the form: prefix:local-name or local-name",
159              name));
160    }
161    String prefix = matcher.group(1);
162
163    if (prefix == null) {
164      prefix = XMLConstants.DEFAULT_NS_PREFIX;
165    }
166
167    String namespace = resolver.resolve(prefix);
168    if (namespace == null) {
169      throw new IllegalArgumentException(
170          String.format("The prefix '%s' is not bound for name '%s'",
171              prefix,
172              name));
173    }
174    return cache.cachedQNameFor(namespace, ObjectUtils.notNull(matcher.group(2)));
175  }
176
177  /**
178   * Provides a callback for resolving namespace prefixes.
179   */
180  @FunctionalInterface
181  public interface PrefixToNamespaceResolver {
182    /**
183     * Get the URI string for the provided namespace prefix.
184     *
185     * @param prefix
186     *          the namespace prefix
187     * @return the URI string or {@code null} if the prefix is unbound
188     */
189    @Nullable
190    String resolve(@NonNull String prefix);
191  }
192
193}
